```lean
import Mathlib

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  -- We work with congruences modulo 7.
  have hmod7 : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] ↔ 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff).mpr h
    · intro h
      exact (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff).mp h
  -- The order of `2` modulo 7 is `3`.
  have horder : (2 : ℕ) ^ 3 ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
    dsimp [Nat.ModEq]; norm_num
  -- First direction: if `3 ∣ n` then `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1`.
  constructor
  · intro h7
    -- From `h7` we get the congruence.
    have hcong : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := (hmod7).mpr h7
    -- Write `n = 3 * k`.
    rcases Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero (by
      have : n % 3 = 0 := by
        -- Reduce the exponent modulo 3 using the order.
        have : (2 ^ n) ≡ (2 ^ (n % 3)) [MOD 7] := by
          -- Decompose `n`.
          have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := (Nat.div_mod_eq_mul_add_mod n 3).symm
          -- Use `pow_add` and `pow_mul`.
          have : 2 ^ n = 2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3) := by simpa [hdecomp]
          calc
            (2 ^ n) % 7
                = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * (2 ^ (n % 3))) % 7 := by
                  simpa [Nat.pow_add, Nat.pow_mul] using congrArg (fun m => (2 ^ m) % 7) this
            _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) * (2 ^ (n % 3))) % 7 := by
                  simpa [Nat.pow_mul] using rfl
            _ ≡ (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3))) [MOD 7] := by
                  simpa [horder, Nat.ModEq, Nat.mul_comm] using
                    (Nat.ModEq.mul_left _ (Nat.ModEq.pow (by
                      dsimp [Nat.ModEq]; norm_num) (n / 3))).trans
            _ ≡ 2 ^ (n % 3) [MOD 7] := by
                  simpa [Nat.ModEq] using (Nat.ModEq.mul_left _ (Nat.ModEq.refl 1))
        -- Now `hcong` together with the above gives `2 ^ (n % 3) ≡ 1`.
        have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := hcong.trans (Nat.ModEq.symm this)
        -- Check the three possible residues.
        have hcases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := Nat.mod_three_eq_zero_or_one_or_two n
        rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
        · exact h0
        · exfalso
          have : (2 ^ (1 : ℕ)) % 7 = 2 := by norm_num
          have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 2 := by simpa [h1] using this
          have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := this
          norm_num at this
        · exfalso
          have : (2 ^ (2 : ℕ)) % 7 = 4 := by norm_num
          have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 4 := by simpa [h2] using this
          have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := this
          norm_num at this) with hmod
    exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hmod
  · intro h3
    rcases Nat.exists_eq_mul_left_mod (Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos h3 hn) with ⟨k, rfl⟩
    -- Write `n = 3 * k`.
    have : (2 ^ (3 * k)) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
      simpa [Nat.pow_mul, horder] using (Nat.ModEq.refl (2 ^ 3)).pow k
    exact (hmod7).mp ((Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff).mpr this)

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (b): no positive `n` has `7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1`. -/
theorem p09_b (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ¬7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1 := by
  -- Suppose `7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1`. Then `2 ^ n ≡ -1 [MOD 7]`.
  intro h
  have hcong : (2 ^ n) ≡ (7 - 1) [MOD 7] := by
    -- `7 - 1 = 6 ≡ -1 (mod 7)`.
    have : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 0 := (Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero).1 h
    have : ((2 ^ n) % 7 + 1 % 7) % 7 = 0 := by
      simpa [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by decide : 1 < 7)] using this
    have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 6 := by
      have : (2 ^ n) % 7 + 1 = 7 := by
        have : ((2 ^ n) % 7 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa using this
        have hlt : (2 ^ n) % 7 + 1 < 7 := by
          have : (2 ^ n) % 7 < 7 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
          linarith
        exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt this
      simpa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by decide : 6 < 7)] using this
    dsimp [Nat.ModEq]
    simpa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by decide : 6 < 7)] using this
  -- Reduce the exponent modulo 3 as in part (a).
  have hpow : (2 ^ n) ≡ (2 ^ (n % 3)) [MOD 7] := by
    -- Same decomposition as in part (a).
    have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := (Nat.div_mod_eq_mul_add_mod n 3).symm
    have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * (2 ^ (n % 3))) % 7 := by
      simpa [Nat.pow_add, Nat.pow_mul, hdecomp] using rfl
    have h3 : (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
      simpa [Nat.pow_mul, Nat.ModEq, Nat.mul_comm] using
        (Nat.ModEq.refl (2 ^ 3)).pow (n / 3) |>.trans (by
          dsimp [Nat.ModEq]; norm_num)
    have : ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * (2 ^ (n % 3))) % 7 ≡ (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 [MOD 7] :=
      (Nat.ModEq.mul_left _ h3).trans (Nat.ModEq.refl _)
    simpa [Nat.ModEq] using this
  have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) ≡ 6 [MOD 7] := hcong.trans (Nat.ModEq.symm hpow)
  -- Check the three possible residues of `n % 3`.
  have hcases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := Nat.mod_three_eq_zero_or_one_or_two n
  rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
  · -- If `n % 3 = 0` then `2 ^ (n % 3) = 1`, contradiction.
    have : (2 ^ (0 : ℕ)) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
    have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by simpa [h0] using this
    have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
      dsimp [Nat.ModEq]; simpa using this
    have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) ≡ 6 [MOD 7] := this.trans (Nat.ModEq.symm this)
    norm_num at this
  · -- If `n % 3 = 1` then `2 ^ (n % 3) = 2`, contradiction.
    have : (2 ^ (1 : ℕ)) % 7 = 2 := by norm_num
    have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 2 := by simpa [h1] using this
    have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) ≡ 2 [MOD 7] := by dsimp [Nat.ModEq]; simpa using this
    have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) ≡ 6 [MOD 7] := this.trans (Nat.ModEq.symm this)
    norm_num at this
  · -- If `n % 3 = 2` then `2 ^ (n % 3) = 4`, contradiction.
    have : (2 ^ (2 : ℕ)) % 7 = 4 := by norm_num
    have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 4 := by simpa [h2] using this
    have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) ≡ 4 [MOD 7] := by dsimp [Nat.ModEq]; simpa using this
    have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) ≡ 6 [MOD 7] := this.trans (Nat.ModEq.symm this)
```
    norm_num at this

```lean
import Mathlib

/-- Lemma describing the value of 2^n mod 7 based on n mod 3. -/
lemma pow_two_mod_7 (n : ℕ) : 2 ^ n % 7 = if n % 3 = 0 then 1 else if n % 3 = 1 then 2 else 4 := by
  have h_main : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := by
    rw [← Nat.mod_add_div n 3]
    simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.add_mod]
    norm_num
    have h8 : 8 % 7 = 1 := by decide
    have h8_pow : ∀ k, 8 ^ k % 7 = 1 := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k ih =>
        simp [pow_succ, Nat.mul_mod, ih, h8]
        norm_num
    rw [h8_pow (n / 3)]
    simp
  rw [h_main]
  have h_mod : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
  rcases h_mod with h | h | h
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]
```
